alicubi

adverb

somewhere (place where)

In this lexicon

  • somewhere

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ad. 3.4.7: utinam hīc prope adesset alicubi (Lewis & Short); Atticus in Cic. Att. 9.10: sī salvus sit Pompejus et cōnstiterit alicubi (Lewis & Short)
